page.layout: One column of index entries, Hebrew words at right with page references beside them, in the order of the printed lines; running head "INDEX" at top centre; catchword at foot left.

main_text.l: גוים | quomodò distinguendi à עמים? | p. 378.
חלף | cum voce רוח pro pervadere. | p. 266.

page.notes: The catchword יגע sits at the lower left, not the usual right position; it is read as the catchword because it anticipates the next page's entries. The Hebrew letter ו is a single vav, and ז a single zayin, both printed as headwords. The "(269." at the right of the ז line is copied as printed; its closing bracket is absent in the scan. The "pervadere." line ends with a colon-like mark that is read as a stop. No page number or signature is printed.
